quote: the question of whether there exists a covering system whose moduli are distinct and all odd appears to have first been asked by Erdős in 1965
note: Also known as the Erdős-Selfridge problem, as Selfridge formulated his own belief about the problem's answer. The problem asks whether a covering system of ℤ exists whose moduli are all odd, distinct, and greater than 1.
